events.name: Bash
events.head: Read T-229 latest log and check commit ancestry

events.name: Bash
events.head: List recent revops-centre deployments
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud && timeout 60 npx wrangler deployments list --name revops-centre 2>/dev/null | tail -12

events.name: Bash
events.head: List deployments using local wrangler config
events.input: $ ls wrangler*; timeout 90 npx wrangler deployments list 2>&1 | grep -E "Created|Version|Message" | tail -9

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show raw deployments list output
events.input: $ timeout 90 npx wrangler deployments list 2>&1 | tail -25

events.name: Bash
events.head: List recent revops-centre deployments
events.input: $ npx wrangler deployments list 2>&1 | grep -E "Created|Version\(s\)|Message|^ +[0-9a-f]{8}" | tail -8
